headword: {北原白秋|きたはらはくしゅう}

definitions.explanation: A poet of the Meiji to early Shōwa periods, known for sensuous symbolist verse, tanka, and above all the words of many children's songs that Japanese children still sing.

examples.japanese: {北原白秋|きたはらはくしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{福岡県|ふくおかけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柳川|やながわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: Kitahara Hakushū was born in Yanagawa, Fukuoka Prefecture.

examples.japanese: 「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{北原白秋|きたはらはくしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作詞|さくし}→作詞：05233_sakushi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{童謡|どうよう}→童謡：03480_douyou⟧だ。
examples.english: "Kono Michi" is a children's song with words by Kitahara Hakushū.

examples.japanese: {北原白秋|きたはらはくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧{柳川|やながわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水路|すいろ}→水路：13264_suiro⟧や⟦{町並|まちな}み→町並み：10435_machinami⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{込|こ}められている→込める：01945_komeru⟧。
examples.english: Kitahara Hakushū's poems are full of feeling for the canals and streets of his hometown, Yanagawa.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Many of the songs every Japanese child learns have words by {白秋|はくしゅう}: 「からたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧」, 「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧」, 「ペチカ」, 「あめふり」 (with its refrain ピッチピッチ チャップチャップ). His first collection, 「{邪宗門|じゃしゅうもん}」 (1909), made his name as a poet. He is usually called simply {白秋|はくしゅう}, a pen name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白秋|はくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{童謡|どうよう}→童謡：03480_douyou⟧: Hakushū's children's songs
- {北原白秋|きたはらはくしゅう}⟦{作詞|さくし}→作詞：05233_sakushi⟧: words by Kitahara Hakushū
